judgement.reason: LightRAG supports PostgreSQL storage backends selectable by settings, so the local-storage fix is a contained configuration change.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume ./data/rag_storage:/app/data/rag_storage (docker-compose.yml lightrag), volume ./data/inputs:/app/data/inputs (docker-compose.yml lightrag), volume ./data/prompts:/app/data/prompts (docker-compose.yml lightrag)
reviews.reason: The shown files only map rag_storage, inputs and prompts to local paths and show no setting that moves this data to PostgreSQL, Redis or S3, so the local disk state is still unproven to be unneeded.
